channel.title: Euroreveal Magazine
channel.description: Discover what makes your euro coins special, from rare issues to the change in your pocket.

item.title: What is the Italian 2002 Mole one cent coin worth?
item.description: In 2013 Bolaffi put a used Italian Mole cent at around €1,500. The rare error has a 1 on the common side and the Mole tower on the national side.

item.title: Is Monaco’s Grace Kelly 2 euro coin really that valuable?
item.description: Yes. An uncirculated Grace Kelly coin from 2007 in its case is valued at about €2,300 to €3,359. Monaco never officially put it into circulation.

item.title: Which 2 euro coins are worth money?
item.description: Monaco’s Grace Kelly and fortress coins and the 2024 Cyprus commemorative are among the valuable examples. The prices apply to collector editions.
